notes.title: New Game Mechanics!!
notes.content:
h2][b]Hello, guys!![/b][/h2]

I am happy to announce that new features have been added! New puzzle mechanics and levels are currently in development!

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Gravity pads
[*] New cloning system
[*] Better controls
[*] Slider switch
[*] Projections (Projected clones—same clones, just with a fresh new design!)
[/olist]

On a side note… I’m pretty close to failing my exams 😭. Wish me luck!
